subject.title: fix: bind macOS node allowlist commands safely

question: Should macOS node execution intentionally stop loading login-shell startup files so exact allowlist approvals can bind safely?
rationale: The shared constructor receives platform metadata but not the node’s security policy, so the safe focused fix changes shell initialization for all macOS node execution rather than allowlist mode alone.

options.title: Accept non-login macOS transport
options.body: Land the focused patch and make the host’s safe reusable-binding contract authoritative for Mac node execution.

options.title: Add policy-aware negotiation
options.body: Pause and introduce a capability or policy signal before selecting `sh -c`, accepting the added protocol and compatibility surface.
